description: Accept PayPal on checkouts using the merchant's OWN PayPal Business account. They create a REST app in their PayPal developer dashboard and give you the client ID + secret. Credentials are validated live and stored encrypted. First-party — money settles in their PayPal, alongside their Stripe. Note: PayPal covers the main purchase (and bumps); the one-click upsell and subscriptions stay on Stripe for now. PayPal is a PAID-PLAN feature — on a free plan this returns a plan_required error; founding members have it included. If it errors with plan_required, tell the seller to upgrade (card via Stripe still works on every plan) rather than retrying.
name: connect_paypal
title: Connect PayPal
